妹.name: Younger Sister
妹.meaning: A <radical>woman</radical> who is <radical>not yet</radical> grown up. She's your <kanji>younger sister</kanji>.
妹.reading: She's always stealing your microphone, まい. On its own it's いもうと.

姉.name: Older Sister
姉.meaning: A <radical>woman</radical> who runs the <radical>market</radical> stall. That's your <kanji>older sister</kanji>, and she's in charge.
姉.reading: She sells sheep, し. On its own it's あね, or おねえさん.

事.name: Thing
事.meaning: A <radical>mouth</radical>, a <radical>broom</radical> and a <radical>barb</radical> on one stick. A stick with every <kanji>thing</kanji> hanging off it.
事.reading: You strap it to your jeep, じ. 仕事 is work; 事 on its own is こと.

発.name: Departure
発.meaning: <radical>Two</radical> <radical>legs</radical> under a <radical>tent</radical> flap. They're sticking out because it's time for <kanji>departure</kanji>.
発.reading: Grab your hat, はつ, on the way out. 出発 is departure; 発音 pronunciation.

者.name: Someone
者.meaning: An <radical>old man</radical> under the <radical>sun</radical>. Who's that? Just <kanji>someone</kanji>.
者.reading: He's feeding a shark, しゃ. It's used as a suffix for people: 医者 (doctor), 学者 (scholar).

業.name: Business
業.meaning: A <radical>drop</radical> on top, a <radical>sheep</radical> in the middle and a <radical>tree</radical> at the bottom. Wool, wood and water: the whole village's <kanji>business</kanji>.
業.reading: The business sells gyoza, ぎょう. 授業 is a class; 工業 industry.

員.name: Member
員.meaning: A <radical>mouth</radical> above a <radical>shell</radical>. You feed the mouth with money, and you're a <kanji>member</kanji> of the staff.
員.reading: The staff all stay at an inn, いん. 会社員 is a company employee; 店員 a clerk.

開.name: Open
開.meaning: A <radical>gate</radical> with something <radical>dry</radical> propping it. They wedged it <kanji>open</kanji> with a stick.
開.reading: Fly a kite, かい, through the open gate. 開く is to open.

問.name: Question
問.meaning: A <radical>mouth</radical> in a <radical>gate</radical>. The gatekeeper asks a <kanji>question</kanji> before you can pass.
問.reading: The gatekeeper is a monk, もん. 問題 is a problem; 質問 a question.

代.name: Substitute
代.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> at a <radical>ceremony</radical> standing in for someone else. They're the <kanji>substitute</kanji>.
代.reading: They roll a die, だい, to decide who goes. 時代 is an era; 代わり a substitute.

重.name: Heavy
重.meaning: A <radical>thousand</radical> <radical>village</radical>s piled on top of each other. Very <kanji>heavy</kanji>.
重.reading: Crushed underneath is a juice box, じゅう. 重い is heavy. Also ちょう, as in 貴重.

動.name: Move
動.meaning: Something <radical>heavy</radical> plus <radical>power</radical>. You need power to <kanji>move</kanji> something heavy.
動.reading: It's a giant donut, どう. 動く is to move; 運動 exercise.

主.name: Master
主.meaning: A <radical>king</radical> in a <radical>top hat</radical>. He's the <kanji>master</kanji> of the house.
主.reading: Polish the master's shoes, しゅ. 主人 is husband or master; 主な means main.

題.name: Topic
題.meaning: Something <radical>proper</radical> next to a <radical>head</radical>. What's the proper thing on your head right now? The <kanji>topic</kanji>.
題.reading: Roll a die, だい, to pick the topic. 問題 is a problem; 宿題 homework.

意.name: Idea
意.meaning: A <radical>sound</radical> over your <radical>heart</radical>. When your heart makes a sound, you've had an <kanji>idea</kanji>.
意.reading: The idea is an eel, い. It's slippery. 意味 is meaning; 注意 caution.

度.name: Degree
度.meaning: A <radical>stool</radical> and a <radical>cross</radical> under a <radical>canopy</radical>. You sit on the stool and mark each <kanji>degree</kanji> on the thermometer.
度.reading: Knock on the door, ど, every time it goes up one degree. 今度 is next time; 三度 three times.

持.name: Hold
持.meaning: <radical>Fingers</radical> next to a <radical>temple</radical>. You <kanji>hold</kanji> the temple up with your fingers.
持.reading: "もつ!" You're holding a moth in your fingers too. 持つ is to hold. In compounds it's じ, a jeep: 支持 (support). 気持ち (feeling) uses もち.

世.name: World
世.meaning: Three tens joined together, thirty years. That's one generation, and each generation makes its own <kanji>world</kanji>.
世.reading: Each generation needs a set of dishes, せ. 世界 is the world. Also せい, as in 二十世紀.

安.name: Cheap
安.meaning: A <radical>woman</radical> safe under a <radical>roof</radical>. She can <kanji>relax</kanji>. And the rent is <kanji>cheap</kanji>.
安.reading: やす: it's so cheap you shout "yes!" 安い is cheap. In compounds it's あん, like an ant: 安心, relief.

院.name: Institution
院.meaning: A <radical>building</radical> that is <radical>perfect</radical>ly organised. It's an <kanji>institution</kanji>, like a hospital.
院.reading: It used to be an inn, いん. 病院 is a hospital; 大学院 grad school.

界.name: World
界.meaning: A <radical>rice paddy</radical> with a guard to <radical>mediate</radical> disputes at its edge. Every field has a <kanji>boundary</kanji>, and all of them together make up the <kanji>world</kanji>.
界.reading: Fly a kite, かい, over the boundary. 世界 is the world.

集.name: Gather
集.meaning: <radical>Turkey</radical>s in a <radical>tree</radical>. They <kanji>gather</kanji> there every evening.
集.reading: Each one has a shoe, しゅう, in its beak. 集める is to collect.

物.name: Thing
物.meaning: A <radical>cow</radical> next to a <radical>banner</radical>. In the market, the cow and the banner are both <kanji>thing</kanji>s for sale.
物.reading: It's all packed in a boot, ぶつ. 動物 is an animal; もの on its own is a thing.

使.name: Use
使.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> and an <radical>officer</radical>. The officer knows how to <kanji>use</kanji> people.
使.reading: The officer sheep, し, uses everyone. 使う is to use; 大使館 an embassy.

品.name: Goods
品.meaning: Three <radical>mouth</radical>s stacked like boxes. It's a pile of <kanji>goods</kanji>.
品.reading: The goods are stored behind a hinged door, ひん. 品物 is goods; 作品 a work of art.

死.name: Death
死.meaning: <radical>Bones</radical> and a <radical>spoon</radical>. When all that's left is bones and a spoon, that's <kanji>death</kanji>.
死.reading: A sheep, し, mourns. し sounds like "death", which is why four (四) is unlucky. 死ぬ is to die.

始.name: Begin
始.meaning: A <radical>woman</radical> steps up on a <radical>pedestal</radical>. The show is about to <kanji>begin</kanji>.
始.reading: It begins with a sheep, し, dancing. 始める is to begin.

運.name: Carry
運.meaning: The <radical>army</radical> rides a <radical>scooter</radical> to <kanji>carry</kanji> its supplies. With a bit of <kanji>luck</kanji> they'll arrive.
運.reading: Their commander is a grunting caveman, "<reading>うん</reading>". <ja>運動</ja> is exercise; <ja>運転</ja> driving.

終.name: End
終.meaning: <radical>Thread</radical> next to <radical>winter</radical>. When the thread runs out in winter, the year is at its <kanji>end</kanji>.
終.reading: You get to take off your shoes, しゅう. 終わる is to end.

住.name: Live
住.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> next to their <radical>master</radical>. Servants <kanji>live</kanji> in the master's house.
住.reading: They live on juice boxes, じゅう. 住所 is an address; 住む is to live.

真.name: True
真.meaning: A <radical>cross</radical> over a <radical>tool</radical>. A cross-shaped tool to check that the wall is <kanji>true</kanji>, perfectly straight.
真.reading: Check it with your shin, しん. 写真 is a photo; 真ん中 the very middle (ま).

有.name: Have
有.meaning: A hand reaching over the moon (<kanji>月</kanji>). You <kanji>have</kanji> it in your grasp.
有.reading: You have a ukulele, ゆう, too. 有名 is famous.

急.name: Hurry
急.meaning: A <radical>hook</radical> and a <radical>broom</radical> over your <radical>heart</radical>. Something grabs your heart and sweeps it along: <kanji>hurry</kanji>!
急.reading: Grab your cue stick, きゅう, and run. 急ぐ is to hurry; 急行 an express train.

送.name: Send
送.meaning: <radical>Heaven</radical> on a <radical>scooter</radical>. You <kanji>send</kanji> a message all the way up to heaven.
送.reading: You send it in a soda can, そう. 送る is to send; 放送 a broadcast.

転.name: Turn
転.meaning: A <radical>car</radical> next to <radical>two</radical> and something <radical>private</radical>. The car's two wheels <kanji>turn</kanji> in secret.
転.reading: It rolls over a tennis racket, てん. 運転 is driving; 自転車 a bicycle.

研.name: Sharpen
研.meaning: A <radical>stone</radical> next to something <radical>dry</radical>. You rub a dry blade on a stone to <kanji>sharpen</kanji> it. Scholars sharpen their minds too: research.
研.reading: Ken, けん, sharpens everything he owns. 研究 is research.

究.name: Research
究.meaning: <radical>Nine</radical> times down a <radical>hole</radical>. You <kanji>research</kanji> it until you hit the bottom.
究.reading: You poke down with a cue stick, きゅう. 研究 is research.

起.name: Wake Up
起.meaning: <radical>Run</radical> next to <radical>oneself</radical>. You <kanji>wake up</kanji> and run around by yourself.
起.reading: Your alarm is a key, き, dropped on your face. 起きる is to wake up.

着.name: Wear
着.meaning: A <radical>sheep</radical> with a <radical>slide</radical> over its <radical>eye</radical>. It's <kanji>wear</kanji>ing a woolly hat pulled down too far.
着.reading: It walks into a chalkboard, ちゃく. 着る is to wear; 着く to arrive.

病.name: Sick
病.meaning: <radical>Sick</radical>, plus a <radical>third class</radical> ticket. You're <kanji>sick</kanji> from riding third class.
病.reading: A bee, びょう, stung you on the train, too. 病気 is illness; 病院 a hospital.

待.name: Wait
待.meaning: <radical>Going</radical> to the <radical>temple</radical> and having to <kanji>wait</kanji> outside for your turn.
待.reading: You wait with a tie, たい, on, because it's formal. 待つ is to wait; 期待 expectation.

族.name: Tribe
族.meaning: A <radical>direction</radical>, a <radical>gun</radical> and an <radical>arrow</radical>. The whole <kanji>tribe</kanji> arms up and heads in the same direction.
族.reading: They're being chased by a zombie, ぞく. 家族 is family.

銀.name: Silver
銀.meaning: <radical>Gold</radical> with a <radical>root</radical>. Dig up the root of the gold vein and you find <kanji>silver</kanji> too.
銀.reading: Fill a gin bottle, ぎん, with it. 銀行 is a bank.

医.name: Doctor
医.meaning: An <radical>arrow</radical> <radical>hiding</radical> in a box. The <kanji>doctor</kanji> keeps it there after pulling it out of you.
医.reading: The doctor treats an eel, い. 医者 is a doctor.

仕.name: Serve
仕.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> next to a <radical>samurai</radical>. They <kanji>serve</kanji> him.
仕.reading: They bring him a sheep, し. 仕事 is work.

去.name: Past
去.meaning: <radical>Dirt</radical> over something <radical>private</radical>. You bury your secrets in the dirt and leave them in the <kanji>past</kanji>.
去.reading: In the past you lived in Kyoto, きょ. 去年 is last year; 過去 the past (こ).

味.name: Taste
味.meaning: A <radical>mouth</radical> that has <radical>not yet</radical> eaten. You haven't had a <kanji>taste</kanji> yet.
味.reading: Give a taste to Mii, the tiny mouse, み. 意味 is meaning; 趣味 a hobby.

写.name: Copy
写.meaning: A <radical>lid</radical> over something you <radical>give</radical>. You cover it with paper and <kanji>copy</kanji> it before giving it away.
写.reading: A shark, しゃ, poses for a photo. 写真 is a photograph.

注.name: Pour
注.meaning: <radical>Water</radical> and a <radical>master</radical>. The servant <kanji>pour</kanji>s water for the master, very carefully.
注.reading: They pour it over a chew toy, ちゅう, by mistake. 注意 is caution; 注文 an order.

悪.name: Bad
悪.reading: The villain is an acrobat, あく, flipping around. 悪い is bad.

館.name: Building
館.meaning: <radical>Eat</radical> with an <radical>official</radical>. Officials dine in a big fancy <kanji>building</kanji>.
館.reading: A kangaroo, かん, guards the door. 図書館 is a library; 旅館 an inn.

屋.name: Shop
屋.meaning: You <radical>arrive</radical> under a <radical>flag</radical>. That flag hangs outside a <kanji>shop</kanji>.
屋.reading: The shop sells yaks: や. Shops end in 屋: 本屋 (bookshop), 部屋 (room). In compounds it's おく: 屋上, rooftop.

習.name: Learn
習.meaning: <radical>Feathers</radical> over <radical>white</radical>. A baby bird flaps its white feathers again and again to <kanji>learn</kanji> to fly.
習.reading: It practises in a shoe, しゅう. 練習 is practice; 習う to learn.

駅.name: Station
駅.meaning: A <radical>horse</radical> and a <radical>measure</radical>. The old post road had a <kanji>station</kanji> every measured distance where you changed horses.
駅.reading: The stationmaster is an eccentric inventor, えき. 駅 is a station.

洋.name: Ocean
洋.meaning: <radical>Water</radical> and a <radical>sheep</radical>. Sheep sailed across the <kanji>ocean</kanji> from the West.
洋.reading: They do yo-yo tricks, よう, on the deck. 洋服 is Western clothes; 太平洋 the Pacific.

旅.name: Trip
旅.meaning: A <radical>direction</radical>, a <radical>gun</radical> and a <radical>person</radical>. Pick a direction, grab a gun, and go on a <kanji>trip</kanji>.
旅.reading: It's a rodeo trip, りょ. 旅行 is travel; 旅館 an inn.

服.name: Clothes
服.meaning: The <radical>moon</radical>, a <radical>stamp</radical> and a <radical>stool</radical>. You lay your <kanji>clothes</kanji> out on a stool in the moonlight and stamp them flat.
服.reading: Hang them on a hook, ふく. 洋服 is Western clothes.

飲.name: Drink
飲.meaning: <radical>Eat</radical> and <radical>yawn</radical>. Open your mouth wide to <kanji>drink</kanji> as well as eat.
飲.reading: You drink at an inn, いん. 飲む is to drink; 飲み物 a drink.

勉.name: Effort
勉.meaning: An <radical>excuse</radical> won't do. You need <radical>power</radical> and <kanji>effort</kanji>.
勉.reading: You work at your bench, べん, all night. 勉強 is study.

漢.name: China
漢.meaning: <radical>Water</radical>, <radical>grass</radical>, a <radical>mouth</radical> and a <radical>husband</radical>. He crossed the water and grass to bring writing back from <kanji>China</kanji>.
漢.reading: He came back on a kangaroo, かん. 漢字 is kanji, Chinese characters.

不.name: Not
不.meaning: The <radical>ground</radical> with a <radical>stick</radical> and a <radical>slide</radical> hanging below it. The roots can <kanji>not</kanji> grow.
不.reading: It's been stepped on by a hoof, ふ. 不 in front of a word means un-: 不便, inconvenient.

以.name: By Means Of
以.meaning: A <radical>drop</radical> next to a <radical>person</radical>. The person uses the drop <kanji>by means of</kanji> which to measure things. You'll mostly see it in <ja>以上</ja> (more than) and <ja>以下</ja> (less than).
以.reading: The measuring stick is an eel, い. 以上, 以下, 以外 (except).

別.name: Separate
別.meaning: A <radical>mouth</radical>, a <radical>wrap</radical> and a <radical>knife</radical>. Cut the wrapping open to <kanji>separate</kanji> the pieces.
別.reading: You make a bet, べつ, on which piece is bigger. 特別 is special; 別れる to part.

特.name: Special
特.meaning: A <radical>cow</radical> at the <radical>temple</radical>. It's a <kanji>special</kanji> sacred cow.
特.reading: It makes toast, とく, for the monks. 特別 is special.

料.name: Fee
料.meaning: <radical>Rice</radical> measured with a <radical>dipper</radical>. You pay a <kanji>fee</kanji> for each dipperful of ingredients.
料.reading: Pay it at the rodeo, りょう. 料理 is cooking; 料金 a charge.

建.name: Build
建.meaning: A <radical>brush</radical> and a long <radical>stretch</radical>. Draw the plan with a brush, then stretch it out on the ground to <kanji>build</kanji> it.
建.reading: Ken, けん, builds everything in the neighbourhood. 建物 is a building; 建てる to build.

試.name: Try
試.meaning: <radical>Say</radical> the words at the <radical>ceremony</radical>. You <kanji>try</kanji> the speech out first, as a test.
試.reading: You test it on a sheep, し. 試験 is an exam; 試合 a match.

験.name: Test
験.meaning: A <radical>horse</radical> next to a <radical>person</radical> standing on the <radical>ground</radical> with a <radical>mouth</radical> open. Before you buy a horse you <kanji>test</kanji> it, and check its teeth.
験.reading: Ken, けん, rides it round the paddock. 試験 is an exam; 経験 experience.

英.name: English
英.meaning: <radical>Grass</radical> in the <radical>center</radical>. The famous lawns in the middle of an <kanji>English</kanji> town.
英.reading: The English play cards on the lawn: an ace, えい. 英語 is English.

借.name: Borrow
借.meaning: A <radical>person</radical> from <radical>long ago</radical>. They <kanji>borrow</kanji>ed it long ago and never brought it back.
借.reading: They borrowed your shack, しゃく. 借りる is to borrow.

堂.name: Hall
堂.meaning: <radical>Esteem</radical> on the <radical>dirt</radical>. A respected building on its own ground: a great <kanji>hall</kanji>.
堂.reading: The hall serves donuts, どう. 食堂 is a cafeteria.

飯.name: Meal
飯.meaning: <radical>Eat</radical>, and <radical>against</radical>. Your mother insists you <radical>eat</radical> your <kanji>meal</kanji>, and you're against it.
飯.reading: You eat it with your hand, はん. ご飯 is rice or a meal; 朝ご飯 breakfast.

質.name: Quality
質.meaning: Two <radical>axe</radical>s over a <radical>shell</radical>. You test the <kanji>quality</kanji> of the coin by hitting it with an axe.
質.reading: You wipe it on your shirt, しつ. 質問 is a question; 品質 quality.

貸.name: Lend
貸.meaning: A <radical>substitute</radical> over a <radical>shell</radical>. You <kanji>lend</kanji> money to a friend as a substitute for theirs.
貸.reading: かす: lend it and the money is gone, like cash. 貸す is to lend. In compounds it's たい.

私.name: I
私.meaning: <radical>Grain</radical> next to something <radical>private</radical>. My grain, my business: it's about <kanji>I</kanji>, me, myself.
私.reading: The word for I is わたし. In compounds it's し, a sheep, as in 私立 (private).

映.name: Reflect
映.meaning: The <radical>sun</radical> in the <radical>center</radical> of the lake. It's <kanji>reflect</kanji>ed on the water.
映.reading: An ace of spades, えい, projected on the screen. 映画 is a movie.
